address: Nassereinerstraße 98, Sankt Anton am Arlberg, 6580, Austria
bio: After working at top-flight restaurants including the three-star The Table Kevin Fehling in Hamburg, Dennis Ilies has ended up in the Tyrolean mountains – at the exclusive boutique Hotel Tannenhof, to be precise. Alpine-style luxury is not confined to the seven suites; the restaurant also exudes elegance and sophistication. The view through the large windows is magnificent, and the terrace here in this elevated position overlooking St Anton is simply wonderful. The cuisine deserves a special mention: Modern yet rooted in classic culinary tradition, it delivers the highest quality through innovative creations.
